title: Deep learning DR grading tested on handheld non-mydriatic images in India
summary: A commercial algorithm (Zeiss VISUHEALTH-AI DR) developed on mydriatic images was evaluated prospectively on 20,489 eyes of 11,199 people in house-to-house screening across 20 regions of India. Referable DR detection had sensitivity 72.08% and specificity 85.65%, with referable precision only 29.60; gradability sensitivity was 91.22% and specificity 65.06%. Accuracy depends on image quality, and performance was limited for this setting.
ai_technology: Existing deep learning DR grading algorithm (Zeiss VISUHEALTH-AI DR) applied to handheld camera images
